description: Elevated content surface (a panel with radius, shadow and a 1px edge: a hairline on a plain page, transparent under data-backdrop, CanvasText in forced colours). Attribute form: data-canvas on a semantic element, with the variant as its value (data-canvas="flush" | "elevated"). Below 37.5rem every canvas goes flush. Surface elements use bare data-* attributes.

attributes.name: data-variant
attributes.description: Element form only: flush (no radius or shadow) or elevated (larger radius and shadow, 37.5rem and up). The attribute form puts the variant in data-canvas itself.

attributes.name: data-max
attributes.description: Max inline size, centered: narrow / normal / wide (--content-* tokens) or prose (65ch).

attributes.name: data-canvas-depth
attributes.description: Stacked-paper effect with 1 or 2 sheets behind the surface.
